summary: The change removes NPI masking from the income-validation log line in ApplicantValidator.java, writing the raw annual income value (a registered NPI field) directly into a log.warn call. This violates LOG-1, which prohibits any unmasked NPI in application logs on any path. All process obligations (CHG-1 through CHG-4) are satisfied: a proper ticket, independent approval by a change_approver other than the author, approval on the sole commit, and a clean CI run on the final commit. However, the substantive violation of LOG-1 is unambiguous—annual_income is an NPI field per policy-params.json, and the new log statement omits the Mask.npi() call that was present before. The change must be rejected.
